_README: Dataroma superinvestor roster history: one snapshot per calendar quarter, the newest valid Wayback capture of dataroma.com/m/home.php in that quarter.
captured_at is the capture instant (UTC); `data_extract superinvestors -F` dates the snapshot at its day. source_url is the raw (id_) capture; managers maps Dataroma code -> name in page order.
A capture is valid when it lists at least one manager and at least 80% of the previous snapshot's count; a quarter with no valid capture is absent (a logged gap).
Generated file, do not hand-edit: scripts/build_dataroma_roster_history.py --cache-dir DIR --until YYYY-MM-DD.
